claims.explanation: Torin-1 is an ATP-competitive mTORC1/mTORC2 inhibitor, so selective killing likely reflects dependence on PI3K/AKT/mTORC1 signaling and mTORC1-driven translation. Sensitive lines are enriched for PIK3CA, PTEN, and NF2 alterations that activate this axis, while resistant lines more often carry RAS/MTOR lesions that may bypass or blunt mTORC1 inhibition. Expression of mTORC1/S6K1 translation components such as RPS6KB1 and EIF3H may further predict sensitivity.
